summaries.en: yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool that solves the practical problem of downloading videos and audio from thousands of websites when you need offline access or want to archive content. It works by intelligently extracting media streams through extensive site-specific extractors and can merge multiple formats while supporting post-processing filters. You can use it via simple commands to download specific quality formats, extract audio only, or integrate it into scripts for batch processing your favorite educational or entertainment content.
summaries.zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的命令行音视频下载工具，能够从数千个网站下载媒体内容，解决用户需要离线访问或保存网络视频的实际需求。它通过精心设计的站点提取器架构智能解析不同平台的媒体流，支持自动合并视频与音频轨道，并可应用后处理滤镜优化输出质量。用户只需简单命令即可下载指定画质的视频、提取纯音频文件，或将其集成到自动化脚本中批量处理教学资料、技术讲座等有价值内容，非常适合媒体收藏和内容分析场景。

summaries.en: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills is a structured library of 754 cybersecurity skills for AI agents, mapped to five major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. Its key innovation is the agentskills.io standard, which defines skills as composable, framework-aligned capabilities that agents can execute autonomously. Practitioners can integrate it with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or 20+ other platforms to automate tasks like incident response, malware analysis, or cloud security audits, making it a practical toolkit for AI-driven security operations.
summaries.zh: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的结构化网络安全技能库，包含 754 项技能，并映射到 MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF 2.0 等五大安全框架。其核心创新在于 agentskills.io 标准，将技能定义为可组合、与框架对齐的能力单元，使智能体能自主执行安全任务。开发者可将其集成到 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等 20 多个平台中，用于自动化事件响应、恶意软件分析、云安全审计等场景。这套工具让 AI 不仅理解安全知识，更能直接参与安全运营，是构建智能安全助手的基础组件。

summaries.en: Presenton is an open-source AI presentation generator that creates professional slides from simple text prompts, serving as a free alternative to tools like Gamma. Its core strength lies in a modular architecture that separates content generation from slide rendering, allowing users to customize templates and integrate via API. You can use it to quickly generate presentations for meetings, classrooms, or client pitches, or extend it to build your own presentation automation workflow.
summaries.zh: Presenton 是一个开源的人工智能演示文稿生成器，能从简单的文本提示自动创建专业幻灯片，是 Gamma 等工具的免费替代方案。其核心设计亮点在于将内容生成与幻灯片渲染解耦，通过模块化架构支持自定义模板和 API 集成。你可以用它快速生成会议、课堂或客户提案的演示文稿，也可以基于其 API 构建自己的演示自动化工作流，非常适合需要批量生成或定制化演示的场景。

summaries.en: magic-trace is a high-resolution tracing tool that captures and visualizes exactly what a process is doing, down to individual instructions. It uses Intel Processor Trace (PT) to record execution with minimal overhead, then reconstructs the timeline for deep performance analysis. Unlike traditional profilers, it shows every function call and context switch. You can attach it to a running process or start a new one, then inspect the trace in a browser-based viewer. Ideal for debugging latency spikes, understanding complex code paths, or optimizing low-level performance.
summaries.zh: magic-trace 是一款基于 Intel Processor Trace (PT) 技术的高精度追踪工具，能以极低开销捕获并可视化进程执行的每一条指令。它重建完整时间线，展示每次函数调用与上下文切换，支持附加到运行中进程或启动新进程。通过浏览器查看器呈现直观时序图，适用于调试延迟尖峰、分析复杂代码路径及优化底层性能，是系统级调优的有效工具。

summaries.en: LongLive is an infrastructure framework for generating long, high-quality videos with AI models. It introduces NVFP4, a 4-bit floating-point quantization technique that reduces memory usage and speeds up inference without sacrificing quality. The system also uses parallel processing to handle extended video sequences efficiently. Developers can use LongLive to build real-time video generation applications, such as interactive storytelling or dynamic content creation, by leveraging its optimized pipeline for long-form video synthesis.
summaries.zh: LongLive 是一个专为长视频生成设计的基础设施框架，解决了现有模型难以高效生成连贯长视频的难题。其核心技术NVFP4采用4位浮点量化，大幅降低显存占用和计算延迟，同时保持生成质量；结合并行处理机制，能够流畅处理超长视频序列。开发者可直接利用LongLive构建实时视频生成应用，例如交互式故事创作或动态广告生成，其优化管线让长视频合成变得高效可行。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
